name: HSBC HKD Stablecoin
collateral: 1:1 HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets held in segregated accounts under HKMA Stablecoins Ordinance requirements
launchPhaseDetail: Second HKMA-licensed stablecoin issuer; launching H2 2026 integrated into PayMe (3.3M users) and HSBC HK App; peer-to-peer payments and tokenized investment subscriptions; 1:1 backed by HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets in segregated accounts; symbol and ticker not yet confirmed

featuredContent.title: HSBC to launch HKD-denominated stablecoin in second half of 2026
featuredContent.description: HSBC plans to integrate HKD stablecoin into PayMe and HSBC HK App for peer-to-peer payments and tokenized investment subscriptions.

milestones.title: HKMA awards stablecoin license to HSBC
milestones.description: HSBC becomes second HKMA-licensed stablecoin issuer alongside Anchorpoint Financial under Hong Kong's Stablecoins Ordinance.
